handshake.instructions:
Hyperliquid Vault Strategy Intelligence: discover Hyperliquid vaults and review a vault's key strategy metrics (TVL, APR, leader, followers, capacity, withdrawal availability, commission terms, deposit status) from the public Hyperliquid API.

Paid tools (x402, U on BSC, pay to 0xA06Db692d7e28356f80199Ff77E22a0Ef02A3518): list_vaults = 0.01 U, vault_overview = 0.01 U. A tools/call without a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header returns HTTP 402 with the x402 requirements.

declared.name: list_vaults
declared.description: Discover Hyperliquid vaults: filter by open/closed and relationship (normal / parent / child), sort by TVL, APR or creation time, and cap the count. Each row has vault address, name, leader, TVL, APR, closed flag, relationship and creation time.

sort_by.description: Sort order: tvl (default), apr, or created (newest first).

relationship.description: Filter: any (default), normal, parent, or child.

declared.name: vault_overview
declared.description: Review one Hyperliquid vault by address: leader, strategy description, APR, TVL, follower count, distributable and withdrawable capacity, leader commission and fraction, closed flag and deposit availability.
